title: The Gatekeeper
html:
The Gatekeeper and Teleporter (character for size reference)

The Gatekeeper is rated as a Boss. He appears at the end of the the Lower Level of many of the Stages of the Horrific Dungeon of Legend, guarding the Teleporter that takes you to the next Stage.

Although he appears as an Abaddon clone, he does not have all of Abaddon's powers. He is highly resistant to Fire but not immune to it.

At the end of Stage 6 - Lower Cindercore is a particularly tough Gatekeeper along with other mobs and another mini-Boss, the Shadow Queen. This is probably one of the hardest fights in the entire game.

Resistances:

  • Fire: High
  • Shadow: High
  • Ice: Low
